steps.title: Which books could a member read?
steps.description: Which books could a library member read last month? Compare three ways to keep that history on the board. A list for each member is easy to look up. Saving plans and catalogs separately uses less space. Sealed files preserve an audit trail, but reports must wait for each batch.
